description: This Kotlin source file defines an Android AppWidgetProvider for displaying daily astrology details, including widget update logic, database access, and UI updates.

classes.name: AstrologyWidget
classes.description: An AppWidgetProvider class that manages the updating and display of the astrology widget.

methods.name: onUpdate
methods.description: Called when the widget needs to be updated; iterates over all widget instances and calls updateAppWidget.

methods.name: updateAppWidget
methods.description: Fetches astrology data from the database and updates the widget's views accordingly, using runBlocking for coroutine handling.
